The Heights is in Grandview Heights, close to the shops at Grandview Corners and Morgan Crossing and to Highway 99. The strata allows two pets and rentals, per the strata record.
Before you buy at The Heights

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what The Heights owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
